summary: Phase 7 testing complete. Backend: 17/17 new Phase 7 pytests PASS (in /app/backend/tests/test_phase7.py) covering real Yahoo Finance market overview (Nifty=23,123 / BankNifty=54,063.75 / Sensex=73,524.26 — source=yahoo_finance), real stock quote /api/stocks/RELIANCE returning live price 1263.30 INR with rsi/vwap from Alpha Vantage, WhatsApp Twilio LIVE (configured=true, mode=live, has_sid/token/from/to all true), POST /api/whatsapp/test successfully delivered a Twilio WhatsApp message (success=true, source=twilio, sid=SM...), plus regression on auto-login, top-picks, news feed, trades, journal, zerodha/status, zerodha/account, stocks/search. Frontend: Dashboard renders the exact real Yahoo values (NIFTY 50 23,123.00 -1.04%, BANK NIFTY 54,063.75 -0.79%, SENSEX 73,524.26 -0.97%, INDIA VIX 13.9). News page opens articles in an in-app modal (URL stays at /news, Close button + 'Read Full Article' external link with target=_blank work as designed). AI Picks (route /picks) still shows Trade Now / Full AI Report buttons. Portfolio still shows ZERODHA ACCOUNT panel with margins and Zerodha Holdings tab.

minor.issue: day_range is built from raw Yahoo high/low without rounding, producing strings like '1259.199951171875 - 1282.5999755859375'. Should round to 2 decimals.
Real path returns macd=0 and macd_signal=0 as hard-coded placeholders (not real).
volume_ratio is always 1.0 (placeholder) and avg_volume is the latest-day volume, not a true average.
india_vix, market_sentiment, advance_decline are merged from simulated data while top-level source='yahoo_finance' — could mislead clients into believing all fields are real.
Carry-over: stores user-provided phone number with no E.164 validation.

/api/zerodha/quick-trade still returns 500 (KeyError) on missing fields (no Pydantic); /api/journal `days` param still ignored; /api/zerodha/postback no HMAC; WebSocket /api/ws still accepts unauth user_id.

issues: Header chip shows 'LIVE' (AlphaPartner system status) regardless of market state. Backend correctly returns market_status=CLOSED but dashboard never surfaces a 'Market Closed' indicator next to the indices — only Nifty card shows the -1.04% change. Adding a small CLOSED/OPEN badge near Nifty 50 would match the new real-data behavior.
Last row reads '09:15 • Market opened — monitoring live' as a static simulated entry even when the live market is CLOSED. Activity feed should reflect real market_status.
Carry-over: left-most ticker still partially hidden behind sidebar (e.g., '815.29 +5.54%' visible without symbol on the left edge).
Modal summary still shows HTML entities like '&' (e.g., 'wealth creation themes &'). Need to decode entities before rendering. Carry-over: some MoneyControl summaries still contain escaped HTML.
When wired into UI, day_range string will display raw floats like '1259.199951171875 - 1282.5999755859375'. Round in backend or format on frontend.

action_items: Round Yahoo high/low/vwap to 2 decimals before exposing via /api/stocks/{symbol} (and rebuild day_range from rounded values).
Decode HTML entities (e.g., &,  , ) in news article titles & summaries server-side or in News.jsx before rendering.
Surface market_status (OPEN/CLOSED) on Dashboard near the indices and gate AI Activity Feed 'Market opened — monitoring live' line on real status.
(Optional) Replace hard-coded macd/macd_signal=0 and volume_ratio=1.0 with real values or remove them from the real path response to avoid misleading metrics.

Carry-over: Pydantic validation on /api/zerodha/quick-trade; apply `days` cutoff in /api/journal; HMAC verify Zerodha postback; auth WebSocket; data-testid on Trade Now / Place Order / autocomplete / portfolio tabs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~1524 lines — should be split into routers/ package (auth, market, stocks, analysis, trades, portfolio, zerodha, journal, news, monitor, whatsapp, real-market).
services/real_market.py uses a module-level _cache dict — no eviction, will grow unboundedly across symbols. Consider lru_cache with TTL wrapper or capped size.

real_market.fetch_real_stock_quote still falls back to RSI=50 silently when Alpha Vantage rate-limits — UI displays a fake neutral RSI as if real. Should return rsi=None and let UI render 'N/A' instead.

WhatsApp credentials in backend/.env (Twilio SID, Auth Token, From/To numbers) — make sure these are scoped to a dev/test Twilio sub-account, otherwise a leaked .env would let attackers send messages on the production account.
/api/whatsapp/test endpoint has no rate limiting — a malicious authenticated user could spam Twilio and burn credits.
